caveats: Every row was run against a scripted model. That tests the plumbing, not what a real model would say.
The harness ran in a Docker cell on one machine (Docker Desktop, aarch64, Docker 29.5.2). Another Docker host, or another version, is not shown.
A tool gate inside the harness is a guardrail. It stops mistakes, not an attacker with a shell.

rows.reason: this shim starts a session with exactly the tools the door offered, and the door offers only mapped ones, so an unmapped tool is never attached (C7n shows none runs). Whether the door would refuse one was not driven
